_note: Short, accurate one-liners. Places are well-known sites associated with each deity; coordinates are approximate for map pins.

deities.story: Goddess of music, learning and flowing water, often shown holding a biwa lute, much like Saraswati's veena.
The elephant-headed remover of obstacles, worshipped in esoteric Buddhist temples for harmony and success.
Goddess of good fortune, beauty and prosperity, honoured with prayers for a fruitful year.
A fierce form of Shiva who became Japan's smiling god of the harvest, kitchens and abundance.
Guardian of the north and of wealth, transformed in Japan into an armoured protector god.
